title: Scam
body: They advertise on the app that you have a 7-day free trial so you can test the app before you’re charged. I was charged immediately an amount of almost 60 dollars and been told I am not eligible for a refund. DO NOT subscribe to this app thinking you will have 7 days to test it before being charged because this is a scam and they will take the money from you straight away.
author: Stella VMR

title: Not as expected
body:
I hoped for the interaction with the cub and the rewards for the goals and adventures to be better. I keep getting the same lame wall or windows after I send my cub on an adventure. 
I don’t see any tools that are specific for ADHD. 
It does keep my accountable for my daily goals but I can see myself becoming quickly disinterested on this app. Not worth the $60 per year.

title: Charged full amount when requesting free trial
body: Currently arguing with Apple to be refunded for a 12 month subscription after a free trial was requested, then asked for Apple ID again and money taken within 3 minutes. Apple doesn’t have an option to upload images to support claims and has denied my refund, labelling it as ineligible. Hate the app, would never have subscribed.

title: Super unhelpful customer service and a money making excerise
body:
I would rate this app ZERO stars if I could. 

First: it takes advantage of people with ADHD by providing them with genetic templates that they have clearly copied from the myriad of clone apps out there just like this “unique experience” 

Second: When I contacted customer service to request a refund of the subscription on the day the free trial ended, I was told I was sent a reminder, there is no evidence of a notification of this on my phone and I emailed the very minute I saw the charge. Was dismissed without a care $59.99 for not a minute of use, robbed in broad daylight. 

Third: This app is very clearly a money making venture for it’s owners, there is not a shred of care given to people who suffer from Neurodivergence.

SHAME ON YOUR TEAM! 
SHUT THIS APP DOWN.
author: blr4192

title: Helpful, but not for me.
body: Thanks for the trial, it was nice to be able to actually use the interface before deciding. Your app is little more than a gamified version of reminders. The Panda is really cute and I can see how it would appeal to some people, just not me. I really liked the discovery tab, you should really focus and expand on that section of your app. It’s a very handy tool. The journaling and reflection section is also good, but I have other apps for that. This app is definitely worth checking out.
author: Disgruntled guy.

title: Good for adhd
body: I’ve got pretty bad adhd and honestly this app’s pretty good. I feel a bit more put together after getting it lol, not much to say rlly it’s just rlly helpful (it’s not one of those u need to pay for it to be good either and it doesn’t shove adds down ur throat 24/7 🫶)
